Plan for a Healthcare Build a medical chatbot system (Conversational AI modality).

## Recommended repositories
- [huggingface/transformers](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers) ⭐ 130000 — high community adoption; written in Python
- [langchain-ai/langchain](https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchain) ⭐ 90000 — high community adoption; written in Python
- [ollama/ollama](https://github.com/ollama/ollama) ⭐ 90000 — high community adoption; written in Go
- [vllm-project/vllm](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm) ⭐ 30000 — high community adoption; written in Python
- [run-llama/llama_index](https://github.com/run-llama/llama_index) ⭐ 35000 — high community adoption; written in Python

## Recommended models
- [sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2](https://huggingface.co/sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2) — feature-extraction (task: feature-extraction; widely downloaded)
- [mistralai/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3](https://huggingface.co/mistralai/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3) — text-generation (task: text-generation; widely downloaded)
- [meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct](https://huggingface.co/meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct) — text-generation (task: text-generation; widely downloaded)
- [openai/whisper-large-v3](https://huggingface.co/openai/whisper-large-v3) — automatic-speech-recognition (task: automatic-speech-recognition; widely downloaded)
- [BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5](https://huggingface.co/BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5) — feature-extraction (task: feature-extraction; widely downloaded)

## Architecture
System for Healthcare (Build a medical chatbot / Conversational AI):

1. Client — web or API consumers submit requests.
2. API Gateway — auth, rate limits, request routing.
3. Orchestrator — requirement-aware workflow (Build a medical chatbot).
4. Model layer — LLM / task models from Hugging Face or managed APIs.
5. Knowledge layer — application database and prompt context.
6. Persistence — PostgreSQL for sessions and audit; Redis for cache.
7. Observability — logs, metrics, traces.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  U[User] --> FE[Web App]
  FE --> API[API Gateway]
  API --> ORCH[Orchestrator]
  ORCH --> LLM[LLM]
  ORCH --> DB[(PostgreSQL)]
  ORCH --> CACHE[(Redis)]
```

## Tech stack
- Python
- FastAPI
- PostgreSQL
- Docker

## Roadmap
1. Phase 1: Clarify requirements, data sources, and success metrics
1. Phase 2: Prototype model + minimal API with evaluation set
1. Phase 3: Add retrieval/tools, harden prompts, measure quality
1. Phase 4: Productionize auth, caching, monitoring, and deployment
1. Phase 5: Iterate from user feedback and cost/latency budgets

## Deployment
Docker Compose for MVP; migrate to Kubernetes or a managed container platform when traffic grows. Prefer managed LLM APIs early; add self-hosted inference (vLLM/Ollama) when cost or privacy requires it.

## Hardware
CPU-friendly for embeddings/classification; GPU optional for throughput.

## Cost estimate
MVP: $20–200/mo (API + small VPS). Scale: dominated by LLM tokens and GPU inference; cache aggressively and use smaller models for routing.
